parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. The first record is a production initializer in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`). Consolidating these two would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to sample-app demonstration semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent. The duplication is intentional: the sample app re-implements `DebugMetricsProvider.init` locally so it can be self-contained without depending on the production `DebugPanel` package.
